claims.claim: Senators Ron Wyden and Edward Markey wrote to Mark Zuckerberg demanding answers on AI glasses privacy and asked for a response by 25 November.
claims.episode_span: they asked Zuckerberg to respond by 25 November
claims.source_title: Meta's AI Glasses Face Privacy Backlash After Intimate Images Were Reportedly Sent to Human Reviewers
claims.supporting_quote: The senators have asked Zuckerberg to respond by 25 November.

claims.claim: Swedish reporting found third-party labellers in Kenya viewed sexual content recorded through Meta's AI glasses.
claims.episode_span: third-party data labellers in Kenya viewed sexual content
claims.source_title: Meta's AI Glasses Face Privacy Backlash After Intimate Images Were Reportedly Sent to Human Reviewers
claims.supporting_quote: An earlier investigation by two Swedish news outlets found that third-party data labellers in Kenya viewed sexual content recorded through the glasses, according to Gizmodo.

claims.claim: Amazon's third-quarter net sales were $201.9 billion, up 12 percent, and AWS net sales rose 39.3 percent to $46 billion.
claims.episode_span: AWS net sales rose 39.3 percent to $46 billion
claims.source_title: Amazon Q3 sales rise 12% to $201.9B as AWS growth hits 39%
claims.supporting_quote: Amazon Web Services (AWS) net sales jumped 39.3% year-on-year to $46 billion—marking its fastest growth pace in nearly five years and raising its annualized revenue run rate to $184 billion.

claims.claim: Amazon expects 2026 cash capital expenditures of about $220 billion and fourth-quarter net sales of $240 billion to $247 billion.
claims.episode_span: Cash capital expenditure for 2026 remains about $220 billion.
claims.source_title: Amazon Q3 sales rise 12% to $201.9B as AWS growth hits 39%
claims.supporting_quote: The company reiterated that it expects cash capital expenditures (spending on long-term assets such as data centers and equipment) for full-year 2026 to reach approximately $220 billion, driven primarily by investments in artificial intelligence infrastructure.

claims.claim: Amazon reported a free-cash-flow deficit of $42.4 billion over the 12 months through September and a $578 billion contracted backlog.
claims.episode_span: free cash flow was negative $42.4 billion
claims.source_title: Amazon Misses Earnings, AWS Revenue Jumps 39% as Shares Drop More Than 7%
claims.supporting_quote: Amazon said it recorded a free cash flow (FCF) deficit of $42.4 billion over the 12 months through the end of September, and it said cash outflows were up 386% from the same period a year earlier.

claims.claim: Nvidia is in talks to provide credit guarantees for an Nscale data center Anthropic plans to use, described as a 460-megawatt site linked to a $45 billion project, and the deal is not signed.
claims.episode_span: billions of dollars in credit guarantees for debt on a 460-megawatt centre
claims.source_title: Nvidia Moves to Backstop a Cloud Provider’s $45 Billion Anthropic Project
claims.supporting_quote: Nvidia is in talks to provide Nscale, a young AI cloud provider, with billions of dollars in credit guarantees for debt to develop a 460-megawatt data center that Anthropic plans to use, according to people with knowledge of the deal discussions.

claims.claim: Reddit CEO Steve Huffman said Google's AI search modes do not drive traffic, and October search referrals fell by more than 1 million on average.
claims.episode_span: search traffic in October has dropped by more than 1 million referrals on average
claims.source_title: Reddit’s CEO says Google’s AI Mode ‘does not drive traffic’
claims.supporting_quote: Reddit revealed that search traffic in October has "dropped by more than 1 million referrals on average per

claims.claim: Meta raised $25 billion in Class A shares and $12.5 billion of preferred stock, with 2026 AI capex of $130 billion to $145 billion, according to Simply Wall St.
claims.episode_span: Meta Platforms raised $25 billion in a follow-on Class A share sale and $12.5 billion of preferred stock
claims.source_title: AI Funding Raise Might Change The Case For Investing In Meta (META)
claims.supporting_quote: Meta Platforms has raised fresh capital through a US$25b follow on Class A share sale and US$12.5b preferred issuance, tying the funding directly to a large scale build out of AI infrastructure and Muse related products, alongside expanded collaborations with Nvidia and AMD on chips, networking and software.

claims.claim: Xcode 27.2 shows 8GB of RAM in the new Apple TV 4K and 12GB in the new iPad mini and iPhone Duo.
claims.episode_span: the new fourth-generation Apple TV 4K with the A19 chip has 8GB of RAM
claims.source_title: New Apple TV 4K and iPad Mini: RAM Amounts Revealed
claims.supporting_quote: As expected, the new Apple TV 4K with the A19 chip is equipped with 8GB of RAM, while the new iPad mini with the A20 Pro chip has 12GB of RAM.

claims.claim: TrendForce forecasts 1.2 million to 1.5 million OLED touchscreen MacBook Pro shipments in 2027, with launch on November 6.
claims.episode_span: TrendForce forecasts the new OLED touchscreen MacBook Pro at 1.2 million to 1.5 million units in 2027
claims.source_title: Apple's Touchscreen MacBook Pro Could Ship 1.5M Units in 2027
claims.supporting_quote: Apple's new OLED touchscreen MacBook Pro could ship between 1.2 million and 1.5 million units in 2027, according to a new forecast from market intelligence firm TrendForce.

claims.claim: Fortune 500 Bedrock spend rose nearly 7 times and Bedrock token volume nearly 17 times year over year, and Lambda topped a $1 billion annualized run rate.
claims.episode_span: Fortune 500 companies spent nearly 7 times more on Bedrock year over year.
claims.supporting_quote: Amazon continued to expand the capabilities of its inference service, Amazon Bedrock , and it’s leading to rapid growth, with Fortune 500 companies spending nearly 7x more year-over-year and total Bedrock token volume growing nearly 17x year-over-year.

claims.claim: Meta reportedly ended the glasses contractor relationship and said in August that covering the indicator light prevents recording.
claims.episode_span: Meta ended the contractor relationship after the Swedish investigation
claims.source_title: Meta's AI Glasses Face Privacy Backlash After Intimate Images Were Reportedly Sent to Human Reviewers
claims.supporting_quote: Meta reportedly ended the contractor relationship following the earlier investigation.
